name: Akeno no Yosuga -Twilight Loop-
original_name: アケノヨスガ - Twilight Loop -
source:
Every day at 5 PM, a girl named Akane dies.

The protagonist, Keita, becomes aware of this loop and struggles to change her fate.
However, no matter what choices he makes, her death is inevitable.

As the story unfolds, a shocking truth emerges—
Akane has been dying repeatedly to protect Keita.

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1123990/Akeno_no_Yosuga__Twilight_Loop/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
每天下午5点，一个名叫茜的女孩去世。

主角凯塔意识到了这个循环，并努力改变自己的命运。
然而，无论他做出什么选择，她的死都是不可避免的。

随着故事的展开，一个令人震惊的真相浮出水面——
为了保护凯塔，茜多次死去。

[取自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1123990/Akeno_no_Yosuga__Twilight_Loop/]Steam[/url]]
